Fetch and parse one SIU director's report

Source: R/parse_siu.R
siufprs.Rd

In one call, downloads one director's report from the SIU web site with siufetch() and parses it with siuprs(). It is meant for loops over many report ids: a report that cannot be retrieved gives NULL and a message instead of stopping the loop.

Usage

siufprs(drid, lang = c("en", "fr"))

Arguments

drid

The director's report id: one positive whole number (or a string of one), the drid= query parameter of the report URL on the SIU site.

lang

Report language: "en" (default, the English page) or "fr" (the French page). Partial matching is allowed.

Value

A named character vector of parsed fields, as from siuprs(), or NULL when the fetch fails.

Details

The arguments are checked before any network use, so a bad id or language fails at once. The report is downloaded to a temporary file, which is deleted on exit. Any error from the download (network failure, an HTTP error, no report at that id) is caught and turned into a message of the form "bricklayer: could not fetch SIU report <drid>: <reason>" and a NULL return. Errors from parsing are not caught.

Errors: drid that is not one positive whole number; lang other than "en" or "fr".

Examples

# argument errors come before any network use
try(siufprs("abc"))
#> Error : `drid` must be one positive report number (the drid in the SIU report URL)
try(siufprs(648, lang = "de"))
#> Error : `lang` must be one of "en", "fr", not "de"

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# needs the network: downloads report 648 from the SIU site
f <- siufprs(648)
if (!is.null(f)) f[["police_service"]]
fr <- siufprs(648, lang = "fr")
}
